violated_contract: A conversation that belongs to the live occasion must be a member of the live episode from the moment intake persists it, so Home folds it under the live episode row; membership may not wait for the conversation's own enrichment to finalize.
canonical_prevention: Join at the boundary that creates the visible row (sync intake persistence), keep the finalize-time join only as an idempotent safety net, and cover both boundaries plus the started-before-episode grace in unit tests against the episode service.
